correctness.rationale: Invertibility at zero selected-node resistance follows from connected Laplacian energy and positive stubbornness elsewhere. The equilibrium identity follows by direct substitution into the original linear system. The PD quadratic has strictly positive curvature for every nonconstant response vector, which is proved, and scalar clipping handles finite, infinite and flat boundaries. The path formula, derivative and 540 rational numerical configurations pass exact checks; finite experiments are ancillary to the general proof.

originality.rationale: On the closest examined FJ literature the rank-one update and special neutral-node directional analysis are pre-existing. The stated contribution is the arbitrary-other-stubbornness global one-coordinate optimization classification and constructive strict interior optimum for the quadratic PD objective. Unlike Abebe et al. the objective is not the sum of opinions; unlike Hunter–Zaman the intervention is not placement. Searches and inspected primary sections did not locate a covering theorem; an unindexed equivalent remains plausible.
residual_risks: A broader unindexed theorem on FJ quadratic objectives under one-coordinate resistance may imply this result even without matching terminology.
The known Sherman–Morrison update makes the algebra compact; priority rests on the complete optimization classification and strict interior effect, not on the matrix identity.
Only cited pertinent mathematical sections were read; an exhaustive global literature review or independent external audit has not been performed.
